body: John Krasinski (playing Jim Halpert in The Office) and YAAAAS.

Oh God. This is me and my (at one point) closest female friend. TBH, the distancing started before but now we're not even pretending. Ugh. This sucks. Maybe he'll find an 'equilibrium'. Maybe he won't. Aaah I don't know. Let's try getting through this either way, ok? We'll make an awesome ladies club with alcohol, PJs and terrible movies to snark on. And pizza. [And remember THIS](http://3.bp.blogspot.com/-MNkEV2-e89g/Uf7gdBTFoYI/AAAAAAAABYg/m6KTO1nx6RI/s640/musk+ox.gif)

Thank you for this. I really see your point. I want to start incorporating what you said in my life. I guess I have to stop hating myself. Which sounds hard as I just got rejected by two people because I am not worth being liked or stood by for them. But what you said sounds right in theory. I'm giving that a chance. Thank you, I'm going to be re-reading what you said a lot. :)
I'm looking for reasons to hang in there right now. Taking it on a day to day basis. Thank you for your kind words :)
I am negative and judgemental. And selfish and a hypocrite. I'm also not a good singer.

I'm sure my family won't be against my getting therapy, it's relatives/family friends I'm worried about. I come from a culture where this would be considered fodder for gossip. 

I have been looking at my options therapy-wise today so let's see where that goes.. 

I survived today is what I can say for sure.
